scientific_integrity: Analytic finite-dimensional arguments prove every branch and give explicit extremizers. Floating-point tests are supplementary. No claim of independent verification, priority, or full-literature exclusivity.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for degree-two homogeneous polynomials on real or complex Euclidean unit balls, with one coefficient per distinct monomial. This is not a higher-degree, arbitrary-p, or Bombieri-normalized inequality. An inaccessible focal full text leaves a documented risk of implicit prior coverage.
title: Exact real and complex quadratic Hilbert coefficient constants, with an odd-dimensional gap
